reviews_verbatim.author: Martin Barwikowski
reviews_verbatim.text: Love this place. Coolest owner. Always fits in our boy somehow. Calls back. She has her own pets. Super caring, super hard working. Always go an extra mile to make my six year old smile when she picks up her puppy.

reviews_verbatim.author: Suzanne Marcotullio
reviews_verbatim.text: Great service! Caprice, the owner, is extremely knowledgeable about all kinds of pets. My two Shih Tzu dogs always look amazing after they have been groomed at Reigning Cats and Dogs.

reviews_verbatim.author: Denise Siebers
reviews_verbatim.text: Our pets really loved this place.  These gals were so friendly and made sure the dogs haircut was exactly what we wanted.   We will continue to take our fur babies here.

reviews_verbatim.author: Alexis Albanese
reviews_verbatim.text: I took my fur baby here and they did an excellent job and really seem to love what they do. Will definitely be coming back!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Katelyn
reviews_verbatim.text: i came in for a nail trim on my dog & the groomer cut into my dog’s quick. i get accidents happen but they didn’t inform us it happened nor did they patch it up. on top of this, there was a sort of deep scratch on my dog’s paw as well, …
